comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling homes to buyers with mortgage and title arms; Forestar sells finished lots to builders, a different business.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Mainly a homebuilder selling to homebuyers with mortgage and title services; lot development is secondary, though it is Forestar's owner and customer.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Production homebuilder selling homes to consumers; Forestar is a B2B lot developer, not a builder.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Homebuilder that also develops land and sells finished lots to third-party builders, the closest overlap with Forestar's lot development.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling to consumers, with mortgage and title affiliates; it does not develop lots for sale to other builders.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Homebuilder with mortgage banking, using an option-based lot model; it sells homes to consumers, not lots to builders.
